name: Camera calibration

description: This test routine will be always executed as first one and makes camera calibration.

steps.description: Make camera calibration.

name: Energy metering modes

description:
The test verifies correct availability of the energy metering modes in relation to the system
        configuration.

steps.description: Enable and gradually go to all screens of type SCREEN_ENERGY_DATA.
Read out the value ranges of the parameters that control availability of the energy metering modes from the MMI.

Refresh the screen, capture the image of the currently displayed screen
             and compare expected mode with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed mode matches with the expected one.

steps.description: Rotate right dial to the right to check if another mode is available according to current system configuration.
After last mode verification, capture the image of the currently displayed screen.
steps.expectation: Displayed mode is the same as the last one.

name: Correct display of the energy data on the screen

description: The test verifies correct displaying of the written energy data.

steps.description:
Create local map of the energy metering screens and check
             if screen of type SCREEN_ENERGY_DATA is in this local map.
steps.expectation: Screen of type SCREEN_ENERGY_DATA is in this local map.

steps.description: Gradually enable all screens of type SCREEN_ENERGY_DATA.
Write the generated set of pseudorandom non-empty energy data with several invalid flags.
Enable all energy metering modes.
Go to the screen of type SCREEN_ENERGY_DATA which was enable in step 2.
Set combination of parameters controlling appearance of the displayed energy data.
Compare expected wording of the title with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed title is the same as expected one.

steps.description: If energy metering period is not equal to TOTAL, compare expected appearance of energy bar with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed energy bar matches with expected one.

name: Verification of appearance of main zone items on the energy flow screen

description:
Test of the energy flow screen items 10-1 (heat pump to SH flow),
        10-2 (tank to SH flow) and 10-3 (main zone flow) appearance.

steps.description:
Set combination of parameters controlling appearance of items 10-1 (heat pump to SH flow),
             10-2 (tank to SH flow) and 10-3 (main zone flow) according to MMI_PGF_G03_27.2.
Capture the image of the energy flow screen.
Compare expected color of the image of item 10-1 (heat pump to SH flow) with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed image of item 10-1 (heat pump to SH flow), on the energy flow screen, has the same color as expected one.

name: Verification of appearance of item 1 on the home screen

description: Test of the home screen item 1 appearance (outdoor unit).

name: Schedule timer wizard program presentation

description: Test of the schedule timer wizard overview screen schedule bars.

steps.description:
Load all screens of type SCREEN_SCHEDULE_TIMER_WIZARD
             and set [LWT_Spmode_main] and [LWT_Spmode_add] to default values.
Gradually enable and go to all screens of type SCREEN_SCHEDULE_TIMER_WIZARD.
Write generated schedule program to MMI.
Capture of the currently displayed screen.
Compare expected indication bar with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed indication bar is the same as expected one.

steps.description: Delete the schedule program via user input events.
Capture of the currently displayed screen.
Compare expected indication bar with displayed one.
steps.expectation: The displayed indication is empty, as expected after removing the program.

name: Delete operation via user input events

description: Test of the schedule timer wizard overview screen day delete operation.

steps.description:
Load all screens of type SCREEN_SCHEDULE_TIMER_WIZARD
             and set [LWT_Spmode_main] and [LWT_Spmode_add] to default values.
Gradually enable and go to all screens of type SCREEN_SCHEDULE_TIMER_WIZARD.
Write generated schedule program to MMI.
Trigger delete operation from the day menu.
Capture the image of the currently displayed screen.
Compare expected schedule bar with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed schedule bar is empty as expected.

name: Schedule timer wizard copy-paste operation

description: Test of the schedule timer wizard copy-paste operation.

steps.description:
Load all screens of type SCREEN_SCHEDULE_TIMER_WIZARD
             and set [LWT_Spmode_main] and [LWT_Spmode_add] to default values.
Gradually enable and go to all screens of type SCREEN_SCHEDULE_TIMER_WIZARD.
Write generated schedule program to MMI.
Select and copy one day, paste to other day via user input events.
Capture the image of the currently displayed screen.
Go back to the title.
Day actions indication bars should be displayed on the screen.
steps.expectation: Day actions indication bars are displayed on the screen as it is expected.

steps.expectation: COPY mark indication is correctly displayed on the screen at copied day.

name: Edit widget

description: Test of the schedule timer wizard edit widget.

steps.description:
Load all screens of type SCREEN_SCHEDULE_TIMER_WIZARD
             and set [LWT_Spmode_main] and [LWT_Spmode_add] to default values.
Set the value of [clock_format] to the MMI one by one and perform all the following steps for each set value.
Gradually enable and go to all screens of type SCREEN_SCHEDULE_TIMER_WIZARD.
Write generated schedule program to MMI.
Clear a schedule program via user input events.
Enter edit widget via user input events.
Compare expected first time and value with displayed one.
steps.expectation: First time and value are presented as undefined (--:-- --).

steps.description: Select action value and time via user input events.
Capture the image of the currently displayed screen.
Compare set time and value with displayed one
steps.expectation: Displayed time and value are the same as set ones.

steps.description: Compare expected position of needle pointer with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Needle pointer is visible in expected position on the screen.

steps.description: Slots out of the schedule program range should be empty.
steps.expectation: Slots out of the schedule program are empty as it is expected.

steps.description: Comfirm program via user input events.
Read out program from MMI and compare set program with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Set program and obtained program match. Program is correctly written to the database.

name: Camera calibration

description: This test routine will be always executed as first one and makes camera calibration.

steps.description: Make camera calibration.

name: Verification of correct display of duration heat setpoint and pop-up screen on the UFH screed dryout programming screen

description:
The test verifies the correct time and heat setpoint setting in the required range. The test also verifies
        correct execution of the pop-up screen if the changes which were made should be discarded.

steps.description: Write empty program to {Dryout_schedule}.
Go to A.4.2 (UFH screed dryout programming) screen in menu structure.
steps.expectation: Screen A.4.2 (UFH screed dryout programming) is reached.

steps.description: Gradually increase the value of duration via user input events.
Capture the image of the UFH screed dryout programming screen.
Compare set value of duration with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of duration is the same as set one.

steps.description: Rotate right dial to the right so that the setting of the values heating setpoint can be verified.
Gradually increase the value of heating setpoint via user input event.
Capture the image of the UFH screed dryout programming screen.
Compare set value of heating setpoint with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of heating setpoint is the same as set one.

steps.description: Press "back" button to invoke popup screen "Discard changes".
Capture the image of the popup screen.
Compare expected title of the currently active popup screen with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed title of the currently active popup screen is the same as expected one.

steps.description: Confirm discard changes via user input events.
Read out current breadcrumb.
steps.expectation: UFH screed dryout programming was correctly left after confirmation "Discard changes" on the popup screen.

name: UFH program setting through user input events

description:
The test verifies that up to 20 actions can be set. After each set action, test also verifies
        that the graph in the item 1 was generated correctly.

steps.description: Reboot MMI and wait for state NORMAL.
steps.expectation: State NORMAL is reached in defined timeout.

steps.description: Write empty program to {Dryout_schedule}.
Simulate user input event - press “home” button to close error popup screen.
Go to A.4.2 (UFH screed dryout programming) screen in menu structure.
steps.expectation: Screen A.4.2 (UFH screed dryout programming) is reached.

steps.description: For each action of UFH screed dryout program generate random duration and heating setpoint.
Set generated values of duration and heating setpoint to MMI via user input events.
Capture the image of the UFH screed dryout programming screen.
Compare expected number of action with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed number of the action is the same as expected one.

steps.description: Compare set value of duration with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of duration is the same as set one.

steps.description: Compare set value of heating setpoint with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of heating setpoint is the same as set one.

steps.description:
Compare whether the duration and heating setpoint values displayed in the graph
              correspond to the real values that have been set.
steps.expectation: Obtained points of the duration and heating setpoint match with expected one.

steps.description: Set the entire generated UFH screed dryout program to MMI.
Read out duration of each action from MMI.
steps.expectation: Obtained duration is the same as set duration.

steps.description: Read out heating setpoint of each action from MMI.
steps.expectation: Obtained heating setpoint is the same as set heating setpoint.

name: Correct loading of UFH screed dryout program

description: The test verifies that the program is loaded correctly from the DUT memory.

steps.description: Reboot MMI and wait for state NORMAL.
steps.expectation: State NORMAL is reached in defined timeout.

steps.description: Generate random UFH screed dryout program.
Set the entire generated UFH screed dryout program to MMI.
Simulate user input event - press “home” button to close error popup screen.
Go to A.4.2 (UFH screed dryout programming) screen in menu structure.
steps.expectation: Screen A.4.2 (UFH screed dryout programming) is reached.

steps.description: Capture the image for each action of UFH screed dryout program.
Compare set value of duration with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of duration is the same as set one.

steps.description: Compare set value of heating setpoint with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of heating setpoint is the same as set one.

steps.description:
Compare that the duration and heating setpoint values displayed in the graph
             correspond to the real values that have been set.
steps.expectation: Obtained points of the duration and heating setpoint match with expected one.

name: Camera calibration

description: This test routine will be always executed as first one and makes camera calibration.

steps.description: Make camera calibration.

name: Default WD curve type icon

description: Test of the default WD curve type icon appearance, on WD curve screen, with respect to [indoor_generation] setting.

steps.description: Disable P1P2 communication.
Enter the WD curve screen.
steps.expectation: WD curve screen is reached.

steps.description:
Set combination of parameters controlling appearance of WD curve type icon
             according to MMI_PGF_G03_8.
Capture the image of the WD curve screen.
Compare the expected WD curve type icon with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed image of the WD curve type icon, on WD curve screen, is the same as expected one.

steps.description: Change value of {WD_curve_type} to 0 (2-point) if value of [indoor_generation] is greater then 4.
steps.expectation: WD curve type icon is correctly changed from "slope-offset" to "2-point".

name: Verification of symbols appearance on the weather dependent curve screens

description: Test of the symbols presented on the weather dependent curve screens.

steps.description: Enter the WD curve screen.
steps.expectation: WD curve screen is reached.

steps.description: Disable P1P2 communication.
Set [indoor_generation] and {WD_curve_type} to configuration of the "2-point" input method.
Capture the image of the WD curve screen.
Compare the expected symbol of the outdoor temperature with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed image of the outdoor temperature symbol, on the WD curve screen, is the same as expected one.

steps.description:
Compare the expected symbol of the emitter type with obtained one.
             The appearance of the symbol is based on the system settings.
steps.expectation: Displayed image of the emitter type symbol, on the WD curve screen, is the same as expected one.

steps.description: Compare the expected icon of LWT shift with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed image of the LWT shift icon, on the WD curve screen, is the same as expected one.

steps.description: Compare the expected icon of heating/cooling with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed image of the heating/cooling icon, on the WD curve screen, is the same as expected one.

steps.description: Compare the expected icon of slope/offset with obtained one.
steps.expectation: Displayed image of the slope/offset icon, on WD curve screen, is the same as expected one.

name: Verification of correct display of WD curve limits using 2-point programming method

description: Test of the 2-point programming method of the weather dependent curve.

steps.description: Disable P1P2 communication.

Set [Emitter_type_main] or [Emitter_type_add] to 0 according to current screen
             and wait for EEPROM update.
Set the curve type method to 2-point method.
Enter the WD curve screen.
steps.expectation: WD curve screen is reached.

steps.description: Select limit values on the curve graph widget.
Capture and crop the image of the WD curve screen so that only y-labels can be identified.
Compare range of the DB items defining the WD curve limits and real displayed graph limits.
steps.expectation: Displayed graph limits match with range of DB items defining the WD curve limits.

steps.description: Capture and crop the image of the WD curve screen so that only x-labels can be identified.
Compare range of the DB items defining the WD curve limits and real displayed graph limits.
steps.expectation: Capture and crop the image of the WD curve screen so that only x-labels can be identified.

steps.description: Modify the curve values.
Capture and crop the image of the WD curve screen so that only y-labels can be identified.
Compare range of the DB items defining the WD curve limits and real displayed graph limits.
steps.expectation: Displayed graph limits match with range of DB items defining the WD curve limits.

steps.description: Capture and crop the image of the WD curve screen so that only x-labels can be identified.
Compare range of the DB items defining the WD curve limits and real displayed graph limits.
steps.expectation: Displayed graph limits match with range of DB items defining the WD curve limits.

steps.description: Press "Enter" to confirm the changes.
Read out DB items defining the WD curve limits.
steps.expectation: DB items defining the WD curve limits are correctly set to MMI.

name: Verification of correct display of WD curve limits using slope-offset programming method

description: Test of slope-offset programming method of the weather depenedent curve.

steps.description: Disable P1P2 communication.
Set [indoor_generation] = 5, set the curve type method to slope-offset method and wait for update EEPROM.
Enter the WD curve screen.
steps.expectation: WD curve screen is reached.

steps.description: Read out ranges and current values of the DB items defining the WD curve limits from MMI.
Calcute expected values of the slope and offset based on the current database values.
Capture the image of the WD curve screen and rotate left dial to right.
Compare calculated value of the slope with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of the slope is the same as calculated value of the slope.

steps.description: Capture the image of the WD curve screen and rotate left dial to right.
Compare calculated value of the offset with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of the offset is the same as calculated value of the offset.

steps.description: Set curve values to MMI.
Refresh the WD curve screen and pres "Enter" to confirm WD curve.
Read out the value of point x1 from the MMI.
steps.expectation: Value of point x1 is correctly set to MMI.

steps.description: Read out the value of point x2 from the MMI.
steps.expectation: Value of point x2 is correctly set to MMI.

steps.description: Read out the value of point y1 from the MMI.
steps.expectation: Value of point y1 is correctly set to MMI.

steps.description: Read out the value of point y2 from the MMI.
steps.expectation: Value of point y2 is correctly set to MMI.

name: Verification of display of set date-time

description: Test verifies correctness of Adjusting multiple parameter screen setting date-time.

steps.description:
Gradually go to the screens of type SCREEN_ADJUSTING_MULTIPLE_PARAMETER
             and set random system date-time to MMI.
Gradually increase value of tested parameter via user input events.
Capture the image of the screen with each change.
Compare set value of the tested parameter with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed value of tested parameter is the same as set one.

steps.description: Read out system date-time from MMI.
steps.expectation: Value is correctly written to date-time in MMI.

steps.description: Go to 7.2.5 (month) screen.
Change the month by scrolling right dial to the right and for each change capture the image of the screen.
Compare expected name of the month with obtained one in each language.
steps.expectation: Displayed name of the month is the same as expected one.

name: Verification of display of set holiday date

description: Test verifies correctness of Adjusting multiple parameter screen setting holiday date.

steps.description: Gradually go to all screens of type SCREEN_ADJUSTING_MULTIPLE_PARAMETER and set holiday date to MMI.
steps.expectation: Selected screen is reached.

steps.description: Set new system date-time to MMI.
Set associated parameter to the set date-time.
Go to currently tested screen.
steps.expectation: Currently tested screen is reached.

steps.description: Capture the image of the currently displayed screen.
Compare expected wording of each date item (year, month, date) with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed wording of each date item (year, month, date) is the same as expected one.

name: Verification of the correct wording of item on the 9.1.4.2 screen

description: Test of the Adjusting Multiple parameter screen 9.1.4.2.

steps.description: Go to Adjusting multiple parameter screen 9.1.4.2.
Gradually change value of [BUH_configuration] and set each value to MMI.
After each change of [BUH_configuration], go to 9.1.4.2 screen.
steps.expectation: Screen 9.1.4.2 is successfully reached.

steps.description: Capture the image of the currently displayed screen.

Read out values of [BUH_configuration], [BUH1_capacity] and [BUH2_capacity] from MMI
             and compare expected wording based on [BUH_configuration] setting with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed wording is the same as expected one which is based on [BUH_configuration] setting.

steps.description: Set [BUH_configuration] = 3.
Read out values of [BUH1_capacity] and [BUH2_capacity] from MMI.
Gradually change the language and after each change set language to MMI.
Go to Adjusting multiple parameter screen 9.1.4.2.
steps.expectation: Screen 9.1.4.2 is successfully reached.

steps.description: Capture the image of the currently displayed screen.

| Compare expected wording with displayed one in all languages.
             | Expected wording:
             | {buh_capacity1} kW / {buh_capacity2} kW Emergency
steps.expectation: Dispayed wording is the same as expected one.

description: This test routine will be always executed as first one and makes camera calibration.

name: Verification of the correct wording of the enum type items values

description:
Test verifies correctness of Adjusting single parameter screens
        enum items values wording.

steps.description: List only adjusting single parameter screen with enum type parameter.
Gradually enable, go to all screens of type SCREEN_ADJUSTING_SINGLE_PARAMETER.
Set associated parameter to the value.
Capture the image of the currently displayed screen.
Compare expected wording of the enum type item value with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed wording of enum type item value is the same as expected one.

name: Correct display of help icon

description:
The test verifies that on each screen that contains explanations,
        help icon is displayed correctly in the upper right corner and
        on the each screen that does not contain explanation the help icon is invisible.
        The test also verifies that for each item that contains an explanation,
        the help icon in front of the name of that item is displayed correctly.

steps.description:
Get the content of all screens described in spec G04 (menu structure).
             For each screen execute steps 2) - 3).
Enable path and go to screen under test.
steps.expectation: Selected screen is reached.

steps.description:
Find explanations related to the tested screen in the obtained screen content.
             If explanations exist, then for each explanation, determine whether it relates
             directly to the screen or to a specific item on the screen.
             For explanation which is directly related to the screen execute steps 5) - 6).
             For explanation which is related to the specific item on the screen
             execute steps 4) - 6).
             If explanations do not exist, also execute steps 5) - 6).
Enable path and go to item under test.
Capture the image of the currently displayed screen.
Compare expected help icon with displayed one.
steps.expectation: Displayed help icon matches with expected one.
